在這個視頻中，我想回答一個問題：“減肥會降低我的胰島素阻抗嗎？” 胰島素阻抗是在糖尿病和糖尿病前期發生的事情。因此，如果您患有糖尿病或糖尿病前期，您也有胰島素阻抗。 胰島素阻抗，因此您的身體開始產生的胰島素量超出其應有的水平。 反過來，這會引起很多問題： •阻止燃燒脂肪的能力 •儲存過多的脂肪 •導致體重達到平台點(穩定點)
因此，如果您減輕體重，可以幫助改善胰島素阻抗嗎？ 答案是：這完全取決於您的減肥方式。如果減肥不正確，您將立即變胖，這是因為如果您不減少碳水，即使您減少熱量和勤奮運動鍛鍊，您也無法真正解決胰島素阻抗問題。

Apple has launched a new US leasing program called Apple Upgrade, letting customers lease an iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Watch through Klarna. But is leasing an Apple device actually worth it, or are you better off buying it outright?
In this video, I break down the real cost of Apple Upgrade using the iPhone 17 Pro as an example. We compare returning the phone after one year, upgrading to a new iPhone every year, buying the phone at the end of the lease, and purchasing it outright before reselling it yourself.
The program can make upgrading more convenient and spread out the cost of expensive devices, but you give up the resale and trade-in value that often makes buying an iPhone the better financial decision. We also look at how Apple Upgrade could make an expensive device like the rumored iPhone Ultra more accessible, along with the potential benefits of leasing an entire Apple ecosystem for work or school.

ns2:group.ns2:description:

For almost twenty years, Apple sold a computer called the Mac Pro. It was their most powerful and pricey desktop made for professionals. This past March, Apple stopped making it. With the model disappearing from Apple's website, and the company confirming to tech outlet 9to5Mac that it had no plans to build another.
For most people, this news was irrelevant. The Mac Pro never sold in very high volume since it was made for a small market of power users that could afford to spend six-thousand-dollars or more on their machine.
In this video I’ll explain the biggest factors that contributed to Apple ending the Mac Pro line, and what that means for people who used them.
